cases.name: date-range-day
cases.description: A range with no times is drawn by day
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="date" range="2026-01-01..2026-01-31" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-range-second
cases.description: precision=second draws a second inside the range, not a day
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="date" range="2026-01-01T00:00:00..2026-01-01T23:59:59" format="ISO_TIME" precision="second"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-today
cases.description: today is the run clock, floored to the day

cases.name: date-now

cases.name: date-open-ended-range

cases.name: date-birth

cases.name: the-two-long-localized-formats
cases.description: LLL and LLLL — month name, day, year and time, assembled per locale. Their own case because they carry commas, which a pipe-joined row would hide.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="T0"><gen type="date" range="2026-03-05T07:09:03..2026-03-05T07:09:03" format="LLL"/></sequence><sequence name="T1"><gen type="date" range="2026-03-05T07:09:03..2026-03-05T07:09:03" format="LLLL"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{T0}} / ${{T1}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: walked-day
cases.description: order=sequential walks a bounded range one day at a time and wraps at the end
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="date" range="2026-01-01..2026-01-04" order="sequential" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: walked-open-axis
cases.description: from= with no end never wraps: row i is the i-th step, across month and year boundaries
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="date" from="2026-12-29" order="sequential" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: walked-calendar-clamp
cases.description: each step is measured from the START, so a clamped February does not drag later months back

cases.name: walked-step-minutes
cases.description: m is the MINUTE in this notation, as it is everywhere the notation is used

cases.name: every-date-locale-renders-its-own-names
cases.description: Every language with a date table renders its own month names, in all five implementations. A table can be written and never wired into the lookup, and then the language falls back to English with nothing anywhere saying so: cs, th and hi were in exactly that state in the Java port, advertised as supported and silently printing "October". Only a rendered string per language catches it, so every table gets a column here as it is added.
